events.title: US Treasury Announces Artificial Yield Cap / Bond Market Intervention
events.description: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced intention to artificially cap runaway yields on US government debt. Treasury doubled bond buyback capacity to $4bn per issue. 30-year Treasury yield hit 5.3% (highest since 2007). Global bond sell-off across US, Japan, Germany, Canada. NYT reports Treasury using 'interventionist tactics' to lower interest rates.

events.title: Historic US-Japan Coordinated Currency Intervention
events.description: First joint US-Japan yen intervention in a generation. Yen hit 164/dollar (weakest since 1986). Coordinated intervention brought it to ~155, but it has since weakened back to ~159. Washington joined to prevent Japan from needing to sell US Treasuries to fund further action. BOJ rate at 1%, intervention may signal willingness to raise sooner.

events.title: 2026 Iran War / Strait of Hormuz Crisis — Active Military Conflict
events.description: US-Israel launched air war against Iran on Feb 28, 2026. Iran retaliated with missile/drone strikes on US embassies, military installations, and oil infrastructure. Strait of Hormuz largely blocked — 20% of global oil/LNG supply disrupted. Iran parliament advancing plans for Hormuz service fees. Commercial vessel traffic through Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb remains depressed. Israel-Gaza-Lebanon escalation continues. Trump says no talks underway with Iran (Aug 18).

events.title: Oil Price Spike / Energy Supply Disruption
events.description: Brent crude at $95.40/bbl (Aug 20), analysts warning could reach $100+. 20% of world's oil and LNG supply disrupted by Hormuz blockade. OPEC+ pledged 206k bpd increase to mitigate. Japanese refiners asked government to release strategic reserves. EIA forecasting elevated prices until oil flows normalize. 2026 Iran war fuel crisis creating economic divide in South America. Gold at $4,620-4,670/oz as safe haven demand surges.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern
events.description: WHO declared PHEIC for Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC. 5,290 confirmed cases, 2,516 deaths (as of Aug 19). 837 patients hospitalized. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments (existing treatments are for Zaire strain). Spread to Uganda. Risk of international spread increasing. EU coordinating response, risk in Europe assessed as very low.

events.title: 5th US Bank Failure of 2026 + Global Bond Market Dislocation
events.description: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank ($68M assets, Philadelphia) became 5th US bank failure of 2026, up from 2 in same period 2025. FDIC estimated $5.5M Deposit Insurance Fund hit. Meanwhile, global bond sell-off sending yields to decade+ highs across US (30yr at 5.3%), UK (10yr at 5.06%), Japan, Germany. Banking deregulation advancing in 2026. Stansberry Research warning of approaching credit crisis. Russian banking system also flagged for systemic crisis risk by late 2026.

scan_summary: 6 events detected across 12 domains. 4 category-5 events: US Treasury bond intervention, US-Japan currency intervention, Iran/Hormuz war + energy shock, Ebola PHEIC. Global bond market dislocation accelerating. Multiple convergence vectors active.
